items.quote: So instead of asking myself what if everything falls apart, ask yourself, what problem can I solve today that somebody would actually pay for?
items.statement: In uncertain times useful people survive faster than emotional people.

items.quote: It's created in usefulness. So instead of asking myself what if everything falls apart, ask yourself, what problem can I solve today that somebody would actually pay for?
items.statement: Instead of panicking, focus on solving a problem that has value.

items.quote: Survival is not created in panic. It's created in usefulness.
items.statement: Survival is not created in panic but in usefulness.

items.quote: Of course, we all can be emotional. For you to survive, you don't have to be the smartest one. You just have to be the most useful.
items.statement: We all can be emotional, but survival requires usefulness.

overview: A statement on survival strategy focusing on usefulness over emotional responses.
